verified_against.method: Code reading of RetrieveWorkspaceEvidence::handleNeeds at fca272e versus 3c38973. Live discovery outcomes cannot be predicted provider-free.

c2_trigger: Discovery runs only for a RETRIEVE need with subject_status topic AND at least one inventoried explicit day/month/year in its grounded spans (compare needs already used discovery). A planner-bound (matched) need goes through C1 only.

route_classification.G1: Month inventoried. C2 discovery if the planner leaves it topic-only and emits retrieve.
route_classification.G2: Month inventoried (background). C2 discovery plus C1 current-answer protection, as for G1.
route_classification.G3: Two days inventoried. C2 discovery, as for G1.
route_classification.G4: Compare. Existing topic-only comparison discovery; comparison control; never C2 evidence.
route_classification.G5: No date. C2 is NOT triggered; existing unbound retrieval. It tests cross-family conflict disclosure on the existing route, not C2 family ambiguity. Reclassified as an existing-route control.
route_classification.R16: Day inventoried. C2 discovery, as for G1. Known regression item.

material_finding: Before C2, a topic-only retrieve need went straight to the existing unbound search. At fca272e, a topic-only retrieve need containing a date now requires discovery to resolve one family. An ambiguous, no-match, rejected or unavailable discovery returns InsufficientEvidence (topic_family_unresolved / topic_family_unavailable) without running the previous unbound search. The approved design (d51ba5a section 2B) said 'report alternative-family unresolved and retain the existing route/disclosure'. Dated topic-only questions that discovery cannot resolve to one family can therefore change from answered to no-answer. This is a regression risk for Block 1 inputs 17-32 and the full population, not limited to this set.
